records.body:

Thanks so much,
Tariq Diallo

records.body:

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

You've got your first project set up in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit -- tasks live inside them. The usual next step is getting a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through what to set up next so the first couple of weeks are genuinely useful for Vantage Labs.

Best,
Chidi
